# The Sound Canvas tone tables: for each model and map, which programs and banks (CC#0)
# hold a tone, and which programs hold a drum set. Capital Tone Fallback (CTF) reads
# them to tell whether the tone asked for is missing on that machine
# (CapitalToneFallback).
#
# Source: the per-model JSON of https://github.com/shingo45endo/tone-browser (f424a483b3eb6cb746087a6e575cc75b57d2c6b3),
#     tables read out of each model's firmware ROM (toneMaps, drumMaps).
# Generated from those tables. Do not edit by hand.
#
# [model n]  The map chosen by CC#32 (bank select LSB) = n. 1 = SC-55 map, 2 = SC-88 map,
#            3 = SC-88Pro map, 4 = SC-8850 map.
# [model]    A model with a single map, which does not read CC#32.
# p: b ...   The banks (CC#0 values) that hold a tone at program p (0–127: the manual's
#            number less one, the value sent over MIDI).
# drums: p ...  The programs that hold a drum set.
#
# The SC-88VL has the same maps as the SC-88, and the SC-8820 as the SC-8850 (checked
# when this file is made).
# The internal tables CC#32 cannot choose (117 and up, from the SC-88Pro on) are left out.
